message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now slugs to `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The cause was `vendor/slugify`, which strips every character outside `a-z`, so `è` and `û` were deleted rather than converted. Since vendor code can't be edited, I changed `src/blog/slug.js` to decompose accented letters (`NFD`) and remove the combining accent marks before calling `slugify`. That is a two-line change, and the vendored library is untouched.

I didn't commit anything.
